summary.zh: 运行集合、查看接口与工作区

description.zh: 读取工作区、集合与接口定义，执行请求并查看环境变量。适合调试第三方接口，或把已有集合当作接口文档查询。连接时在请求头填入 Postman API Key。
description.en: Read workspaces, collections, and API definitions, run requests, and inspect environment variables. Useful for debugging third-party APIs or treating an existing collection as documentation. Supply a Postman API key in the request header.

authHint.zh: 在 Postman 账号设置里生成 API Key 后填入
authHint.en: Generate an API key in your Postman account settings
